en: A vintage sepia-toned view of a European town market square bordered by multi‑story historic buildings with gabled roofs and shopfronts at street level. Several women in long dresses walk across the open square. Simple streetlamps stand along the edge of the plaza. At the top of the image, printed text reads "WURZEN I. SA." on the left and "MARKT." on the right, identifying the scene as the market square of Wurzen.
